description: The case's committed/ folder adds a report-page feature: FR-001 has a unit test, and FR-002 (the Copy button copies the word count) can only be checked by a person, so its Done when starts with 'manual:' in T-1.2 and in the verify task. build-phase implements T-1.1 and T-1.2, verify-spec gives FR-002 'untested', and build-phase does not reopen T-1.2: the phase ends as done with a 'Check by hand:' line that carries the task's check.

must_match.why: an untested row whose check is manual does not stop the phase
T-1.1 and T-1.2 were implemented and nothing was reworked
verify-spec's verdict is reported unchanged: FR-001 met, FR-002 untested

must_match.pattern: ^Check by hand: FR-002: in a browser, open a page saved from `render_report\("one two three"\)`, click Copy, and paste into a text field: `3` is pasted$
must_match.why: the manual check is listed, copied from T-1.2's Done when without the word manual:

must_match.pattern: ^Next: push report-page/phase-1, open a PR titled "report-page phase 1: Report page", and run /code-review$
must_match.why: the hand-off line of a done phase

must_not_match.why: FR-001 has a test and is met
no task is reopened for a manual check
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on report-page/phase-1: T-1.1, T-1.2, then T-1.3, and no Reopen commit.
tasks.md differs from the committed one only in Status lines.
No test claims to prove FR-002, and no reply says the Copy check was made.
